options.name: _faked_session
options.description: An internal parameter used for testing the module.

options.name: additional_properties
options.description: List of additional properties to be returned for each partition, in addition to the default properties (see result description). Mutually exclusive with O(full_properties). The property names are specified with underscores instead of hyphens. On HMCs with an HMC version below 2.14.0, all properties of each partition will be returned if this parameter is specified, but you should not rely on that.

options.name: cpc_name
options.description: Name of the CPC for which the partitions are to be listed. Default: All managed CPCs.

options.name: full_properties
options.description: If True, all properties of each partition will be returned. Default: False. Mutually exclusive with O(additional_properties). Note: Setting this to True causes a loop of 'Get Partition Properties' operations to be executed. It is preferable from a performance perspective to use the O(additional_properties) parameter instead.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: The authentication credentials for the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The hostnames or IP addresses of a single HMC or of a list of redundant HMCs. A single HMC can be specified as a string type or as an HMC list with one item. An HMC list can be specified as a list type or as a string type containing a Python list representation. The first available HMC of a list of redundant HMCs is used for the entire execution of the module.

options.name: log_file
options.description: File path of a log file to which the logic flow of this module as well as interactions with the HMC are logged. If null, logging will be propagated to the Python root logger.
